'''Nundu Bay''' is situated along the southwestern shore of [[Kourna]]. It is a quiet place frequented mostly by fishermen and [[corsair]]s.

==Getting there==
The [[primary quest]] [[Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger]] will conclude in this outpost. That quest, together with [[Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger]], represents a branch in the Nightfall storyline. While both can be completed, completing just one will make the other one optional.

An early [[secondary quest]] in Marga Coast, [[Herds to the Slaughter]], actually leads to a spot that's very near the entrance to this outpost.
